description: Every proposed address must be https and must carry a real host — a probe cannot test anything else.

input.topic: New and newly-emerging competitive moves among South African data-and-analytics competitors
input.watchlist_note: South African IT trade press (ITWeb, BusinessLive, Moneyweb) and the National Treasury eTenders portal.

rubric.condition: Every candidate url starts with the literal prefix https://.
Every candidate url parses to a non-empty hostname.
The output contains zero occurrences of the substring http:// (insecure scheme).
